not-closable.why: The rule's only consequence is 'the result of the execution of this statement is undefined' (see 14.6.10). An undefined result has no spec-derived expected value, so no golden can pin it; a golden would only freeze what this implementation happens to do. Adjudicator confirms a deterministic outcome
